unchanged_settings.order: reserved JSONL order, same for all three
unchanged_settings.prompt: original task contract, named entry point, original supplied assertions; ask edit_file task.py, run_tests, then final full code
unchanged_settings.tools: existing calibration-v2 strict read_file/edit_file/run_tests schemas; virtual workspace, sandbox for execution; final oracle always original assertions
unchanged_settings.serving: existing loopback MLX-LM server, concurrency one, prefill 512, upstream thinking/template parser
unchanged_settings.budget: aggregate across reasoning and all tool/final responses, no retries after task failure
unchanged_settings.limitation: original provided assertions only; not comprehensive hidden correctness tests

operational_details.invalid_tool: record exact error; end task without retry
operational_details.transport_or_server_failure: record attempt; terminate server process without GPU inspection; no retry
operational_details.completion_accounting: response usage completion_tokens, aggregate across at most four responses, includes reasoning; missing/invalid usage ends attempt visibly
operational_details.oracle: existing isolated Docker sandbox and pinned sanitizer; original assertions only
operational_details.final_code: assistant content from final response; never substitute edited workspace for missing final
operational_details.generation_elapsed: sum HTTP request elapsed time including failed requests; conversation elapsed retained separately

memory_policy: Reuse the identical MLX-LM CLI loading/serving path and allocator defaults of the historical behavior servers. BF16 uses existing work/source (24.3 GB); one model/server resident at a time. No training/optimizer state. No memory settings or cache policy changes.
artifact_policy: Export only frozen U step 128. Check scheduled FP32 masters against rolling restart step 128 on host, immutable source/data/target bindings, protected weights, then all parameter digests in a separate fresh process. No optimizer update or resumed run.
control_policy: Separate fresh processes sequentially, U then BF16. One attempt per task; no retry or replacement model on blocker. No S/C/MXFP4 reruns.
diagnostic_categories: redundant actions (exact repeated calls on unchanged source; separately read-after-passing-test)
repair still incorrect under original assertions
working workspace but incorrect final copy
audit_policy: Keep overlaps; distinguish model-supplied tool assertions from original oracle and final source. Sandbox replay is analysis only, never a missing-final score rescue. Preserve literal final_present and additionally substantive final.
selection: No winner selection. S-128 remains rejected. U is a post-hoc control only. No promotion. Opened 32 tasks are diagnostic/regression material for future work.
interpretation: A single run per model does not establish objective superiority or numerical causality. Do not infer overfitting, incorrect gradients or a particular loss mechanism from aggregate scores.
